lines.t: (Solitary dark upright piano, low haunting solo cello intro)
[Verse 1]
(Breathy tone, British accent)
Came to You with empty hands
A broken heart, a borrowed faith
Built a life on shifting sand
And watched it slowly wash away
I chased the love of someone else
Forgot the truth You spoke to me
In the wreckage of myself
You were reaching patiently
[Pre-Chorus]
(Building emotion, raspy tone)
When I was lost inside the night
You called me back into the light
[Chorus]
(Full chest voice belting, raspy British vocal, dramatic piano and weeping cello)
You left me with the fire!
Stayed through every single scar!
Took my ashes and my fear
Showed me exactly who You are!
I was never too far gone
Your grace had made a way
Left me with the fire
And burned the shame away
[Verse 2]
(Intimate, conversational)
Thought forgiveness meant forgetting
Every wound that made me bleed
Mercy isn't weakness now
It's the chains You break in me
I release the words that hurt
I release the love that failed
What I thought would be my end
Was where Your love prevailed
[Bridge]
(Building intensity, vocal strain, weeping cello solo)
Every single tear is seen
Every battle brought me through
Don't even need to understand
Just need to trust in You
(Maximum emotional belt, raspy strain)
When I am weak You give me strength!
When I am lost You lead the way!
YahuShua, I am loved
Nothing can undo Your grace!
[Final Chorus]
(Raw emotional climax, heavy piano and expressive cello)
You left me with the fire!
Stayed through every single scar!
Took my ashes and my fear
And healed my wounded heart!
I was never too far gone
Your mercy made a way
Left me with the fire
And burned the shame away
[Outro]
(Soft piano, lingering solo cello bow, quiet British vocal)
Not defined by what I lost
Not abandoned in the flame
YahuShua met me at the cross
And called me by my name
